## Keyboard input-mode switches (code only, comments removed)

Minimal switches between US Latin, Windows Russian and Chinese IME modes, starting in the corpus's
native mode. `half`: the Chinese IME emits ASCII punctuation; `full`: it emits full-width
punctuation, so every ASCII punctuation mark needs Latin mode. Only the zh rows differ.

## Gluing mutations

Each delimiter is glued to its neighbour by deleting the whitespace between them.
`local`: an error on the joint's line; `distant`: an error elsewhere; `tolerated`: the mutant
parses to the original tree; `silent`: the mutant parses to a different tree.
